# Introduction

# DATA Wrangling


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)

# Import original data
listings <- read.csv("https://ajohns24.github.io/data/NYC_airbnb_kaggle.csv")
nbhd     <- read.csv("https://ajohns24.github.io/data/NYC_nbhd_kaggle.csv")

# Wrangle this into the final airbnb data
set.seed(253)
airbnb <- listings %>% 
  filter(price > 0, price < 1000) %>% 
  sample_n(size = 5000) %>% 
  rename(neighbourhood = neighbourhood_cleansed) %>% 
  left_join(nbhd) %>% 
  select(-neighbourhood, -amenities, -host_response_rate, -calendar_updated)
```

**Extended wrangling**

```{r}
library(dplyr)

airbnb %>%
  select(-c(latitude, longitude, host_response_time, host_is_superhost, host_has_profile_pic, is_location_exact, review_scores_rating, cancellation_policy, require_guest_profile_picture, reviews_per_month)) %>%
  # step_string2factor() %>%
  step_impute_knn() %>%
  head(4)
```
